maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumable packaged snacks (Quest, Atkins, OWYN) that are used up; not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying snacks via grocery, club, mass, and e-commerce retailers, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through brand sales and new products like Quest chips; Atkins and Quest were large deals, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer snack bars, shakes and chips; retailers and consumers can easily switch to competing brands.
